2x2x2 Cube (WCA-recognized) and Clock are the main events of **Double Time Bacolod 2025** and will have the most rounds (three). Subsidiary events of the competition such as Skewb will have two rounds and 3x3x3 Cube and Pyraminx will feature a single round.

Registration for the main events is **FREE**! For those who wish to participate in 3x3x3 Cube, Skewb, and Pyraminx, there will be a small additional fee. See [Payment tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DoubleTimeBacolod2025#52355-payment) for information.

All other necessary information about the competition can be found in the following tabs above. Please be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) before participating.

###### *By registering, competitors and their guests—including but not limited to family members, friends, and guardians—acknowledge that the organizing bodies, their staff, and affiliated individuals will not be liable for any injuries, loss of personal belongings, or emotional distress resulting from participation in this competition.*
